title: Missed-Visit Fee Waivers and Refunds on Appointment Series — Questions Answered
content:
Training note for Patient Services Center representatives on waiving an assessed missed-visit fee on an Appointment Series.

**Rule.** An assessed fee is waived in full, never in part, for exactly one of these reasons, checked in this order: clinic weather closure, when the clinic was closed that day; telehealth connection failure, where the format provides for that waiver; documented emergency, where the format provides for an emergency waiver and the documentation arrived no later than the format's emergency documentation period in calendar days after the appointment date; and first-occurrence courtesy, while the patient's first-occurrence courtesy waivers in the current calendar year are fewer than the format's yearly allowance. A fee waiver is granted only on a request made no later than the format's waiver request period in calendar days after the date the fee was assessed. Days are counted as calendar days from the assessment date, the assessment date itself being day zero. A fee that was already paid and is then waived is refunded to the same payment method within the format's refund period in calendar days.

**Can part of a fee be waived?** No. A waiver removes the whole fee.

**Which reason is recorded when more than one fits?** The first that fits in the order above: clinic weather closure, then telehealth connection failure, then documented emergency, then first-occurrence courtesy. Exactly one reason is recorded.

**How are courtesy waivers counted?** The count is of fees waived for first-occurrence courtesy across all of the patient's series, dated from 1 January to 31 December of the current year. A courtesy waiver is available while that count is below the format's yearly allowance.

**Until when may a waiver be requested?** Through the last day of the request period. With a 14-day period and a fee assessed on the 3rd of a month (day zero), a request on the 17th (day 14) is in time and a request on the 18th (day 15) is not. The assessment date is read from the recorded fee entry.

**What happens to a fee already paid?** It is refunded to the same payment method within the refund period once it is waived.

**Hypothetical sequence.** A Standard 45-Minute Visit Series patient whose clinic was open, whose visit was in person and who has no emergency documentation, and who has had no courtesy waiver this year, may have a fee waived as first-occurrence courtesy on a request made within the request period; a second fee in the same year does not qualify for courtesy under that format's allowance of 1.
